0.4.0-beta / versionCode 16 — native Apple-style UI and Settings connection management
Date: 2026-10-16

Delivery
  APK: nikon-usb-0.4.0-beta-debug.apk
  Size: 238114 bytes
  SHA-256: e3583acbf09df858b10bdac675eacccdfec1559690a834200e5a42591ccbceff
  Build: scripts/build-apk.ps1 -SdkRoot D:/dev/android-sdk -JdkRoot D:/dev/Java/jdk-17.0.19
  APK Signature Scheme v2/v3 verification passed.

Implemented scope
  Native Java Views, cloud-white/graphite themes, blue actions, rounded grouped lists,
  compact source tabs and floating three-destination navigation: presets/album/settings.
  Settings owns Wi-Fi, USB, disconnect, catalog configuration, help and about.
  Content roots display a small status dot and text. A configured address or merely
  enumerated USB device is not considered a verified connection.
  Wi-Fi status follows the verified read-only AlbumController session; USB status
  requires a successful read-only slot probe with a closed session, permission and
  a still-attached device. USB album browsing remains unavailable.
  Imports use the selected verified connection, close the album session first and
  retain the existing fresh capability/empty-slot/confirmation/write/readback guards.
  Pending-result recovery retains the journal's original transport and address.
  Photo transfer prevents connection changes; download cancellation stays reachable.
  GlassBar samples a small local backdrop at most 10fps and uses RenderEffect on
  API31+ only. Older API, low-RAM, power-save, disabled animations and unavailable
  sampling use a solid fallback. Foreground labels are not blurred.

Automated checks
  tests/run.ps1 -JdkHome D:/dev/Java/jdk-17.0.19 passed 7104 checks:
  186 PTP core, 68 NCP structure, 2577 transfer, 148 storage, 955 directory survey,

  These ran during this implementation before the later UI-only layout/list-state
  corrections. The final UI source was compiled and checked on the emulator below;
  this count is not presented as new UI tests or repeated per build.
  git diff --check passed. New GlassBar was also compiled in the final APK.

Independent review
  Correctness review checked connection purposes, session exclusivity, busy guards,
  recovery routing and stale-grid retirement. No outstanding material issue found.
  A fresh native finish reviewer inspected the17 emulator captures and source,
  returning SHIP only for this reviewed phone UI scope. It subsequently checked
  the3 real-phone root captures and found no new visible material defect.
  No web detector ran on native Views; source and actual device captures were used.

Limits
  No new real-camera USB or wireless validation, camera write, pairing compatibility,
  TalkBack, tablet, physical pinch gesture or hardware blur-performance certification.
  The tests and screenshots do not establish wireless preset registration support.
  Synthetic photos and the web proposal's AI atlas are not bundled as preset samples.
  Earlier releases' checks, hashes and screenshots retain their original scope.
